description: For a traveler who has chosen a specific cruise (ship + departure date) and wants the whole trip planned around it: flights, hotels before and after the cruise, and every port day. Checks whether Cruise Planner(크루즈 플래너) knows this sailing and returns a link to the planner where the traveler continues. Ship names are matched exactly; one that does not match returns catalog_ships (exact English names by cruise line) with reason ship_not_in_catalog. Returns found / ambiguous / not_found. When found, sailing shows only nights and embarkation port (UN/LOCODE) to confirm the match. When ambiguous, each candidate shows only departure date, nights and that port; nights and embark_port narrow the match. Does not search, compare or price cruises; returns no itinerary, prices, cabins, ship details or sailing identifiers. planner.ui_language reports the UI language ("en" or "ko") of the returned link. planner.url carries the selection token and query parameters that keep the cruise selected.

departure_date.description: Embarkation date, YYYY-MM-DD, local date at the embarkation port. Required.

embark_port.description: Embarkation port name or UN/LOCODE. Optional; helps when several sailings share the ship and date.

nights.description: Number of nights. Optional; helps when several sailings share the ship and date.

sailing_ref.description: A cruise search provider's sailing reference for the chosen cruise, passed through as given. Optional.

ship_name.description: The exact English ship name, e.g. "MSC Bellissima" or "Norwegian Epic". Required. Matched exactly (case, spacing and punctuation ignored), not by similarity. A name that does not match returns the catalog ships (catalog_ships: English names by cruise line).

user_language.description: The traveler's language as a BCP 47 tag (e.g. "en", "ja", "ko", "zh-TW"). Korean (ko or ko-*) or a missing value opens Korean UI; English (en or en-*) and any other language or invalid tag opens English UI. Valid tags are used for anonymous usage statistics and preserved as a language hint in a chosen-cruise start link. It does not translate narrative answers or saved plan content. The returned ui_language reports the language actually used.

name: start_cruise_plan
title: Start a full trip plan for a chosen cruise
